basic_details.post_name: Assistant Grade-3, Assistant Sub-Inspector (District Unit Cadre), Stenographer (Hindi) and 7 more
basic_details.short_information: Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board (CGSSB), Raipur, has invited applications for 1703 posts in 10 roles. The posts include Assistant Grade-3, Assistant Sub-Inspector (District Unit Cadre), Stenographer (Hindi), Sub-Inspector-A (Stenographer, General Branch) and 6 more. The online application is open from 5 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.
